# provenance for today
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day = "2026-09-21"
paths = [
  "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl",
  os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"),

]
for p in paths:
  print("===", p, "exists", os.path.exists(p))
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    continue
  n=0
  with open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
    for line in f:
      line=line.strip()
      if not line: continue
      try:
        o=json.loads(line)
      except Exception:
        continue
      # try various time fields
      ts = o.get("ts") or o.get("time") or o.get("created_at") or o.get("timestamp") or ""
      s = str(ts)
      if day in s or (isinstance(ts,(int,float)) and datetime.fromtimestamp(ts/1000 if ts>1e12 else ts, TZ).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")==day):
        src = o.get("source") or o.get("kind") or ""
        text = (o.get("text") or o.get("payload") or o.get("message") or o.get("body") or "")
        if isinstance(text, dict):
          text = text.get("text") or text.get("prompt") or str(text)[:200]
        text = str(text).replace("\n"," ")[:180]
        bus = o.get("bus_id") or o.get("id") or ""
        print(f"src={src} bus={bus} ts={s[:32]} :: {text}")
        n+=1
        if n>=40: break
  print("matched", n)
